entries.title: II Samuel 7:1
segments: ¶Now when the king was living in his house, and the Lord had given him rest from war on every side;

entries.title: II Samuel 7:2
segments: The king said to Nathan the prophet, See now, I am living in a house of cedar, but the ark of God is housed inside the curtains of a tent.

entries.title: II Samuel 7:3
segments: And Nathan said to the king, Go and do whatever is in your heart; for the Lord is with you.

entries.title: II Samuel 7:4
segments: ¶Now that night the word of the Lord came to Nathan, saying,

entries.title: II Samuel 7:5
segments: Go and say to my servant David, The Lord says, Are you to be the builder of a house, a living-place for me?

entries.title: II Samuel 7:6
segments: For from the day when I took the children of Israel up out of Egypt till this day, I have had no house, but have gone from place to place in a tent.

entries.title: II Samuel 7:7
segments: In all the places where I went with all the children of Israel, did I ever say to any of the judges of Israel, to whom I gave the care of my people Israel, Why have you not made me a house of cedar?

entries.title: II Samuel 7:8
segments: Then say these words to my servant David, The Lord of armies says, I took you from the fields, from keeping the sheep, so that you might be a ruler over my people, over my people Israel:

entries.title: II Samuel 7:9
segments: And I have been with you wherever you went, cutting off before you all those who were against you; and I will make your name great, like the name of the greatest ones of the earth.

entries.title: II Samuel 7:10
segments: And I will make a resting-place for my people Israel, planting them there, so that they may be living in the place which is theirs, and never again be moved; and never again will they be troubled by evil men as they were at the first,

entries.title: II Samuel 7:11
segments: From the time when I put judges over my people Israel; and I will give you peace from all who are against you. And the Lord says to you that he will make you the head of a line of kings.

entries.title: II Samuel 7:12
segments: And when the time comes for you to go to rest with your fathers, I will put in your place your seed after you, the offspring of your body, and I will make his kingdom strong.

entries.title: II Samuel 7:13
segments: He will be the builder of a house for my name, and I will make the seat of his authority certain for ever.

entries.title: II Samuel 7:14
segments: I will be to him a father and he will be to me a son: if he does wrong, I will give him punishment with the rod of men and with the blows of the children of men;

entries.title: II Samuel 7:15
segments: But my mercy will not be taken away from him, as I took it from him who was before you.

entries.title: II Samuel 7:16
segments: And your family and your kingdom will keep their place before me for ever: the seat of your authority will never be overturned.

entries.title: II Samuel 7:17
segments: So Nathan gave David an account of all these words and this vision.

entries.title: II Samuel 7:18
segments: ¶Then David the king went in and took his seat before the Lord, and said, Who am I, O Lord God, and what is my family, that you have been my guide till now?

entries.title: II Samuel 7:19
segments: And this was only a small thing to you, O Lord God; but your words have even been about the far-off future of your servant's family, O Lord God!

entries.title: II Samuel 7:20
segments: What more may David say to you? for you have knowledge of your servant, O Lord God.

entries.title: II Samuel 7:21
segments: Because of your word and from your heart, you have done all this great work, and let your servant see it.

entries.title: II Samuel 7:22
segments: Truly you are great, O Lord God: there is no one like you and no other God but you, as is clear from everything which has come to our ears.

entries.title: II Samuel 7:23
segments: And what other nation in the earth, like your people Israel, did a god go out to take for himself, to be his people, and to make a name for himself, and to do great and strange things for them, driving out a nation and its gods from before his people?

entries.title: II Samuel 7:24
segments: But you took and made strong for yourself your people Israel, to be your people for ever; and you, Lord, became their God.

entries.title: II Samuel 7:25
segments: And now, O Lord God, may the word which you have said about your servant and about his family, be made certain for ever, and may you do as you have said!

entries.title: II Samuel 7:26
segments: And let your name be made great for ever, and let men say, The Lord of armies is God over Israel: and let the family of David your servant be made strong before you!

entries.title: II Samuel 7:27
segments: For you, O Lord of armies, the God of Israel, have clearly said to your servant, I will make you the head of a family of kings: and so it has come into your servant's heart to make this prayer to you.

entries.title: II Samuel 7:28
segments: And now, O Lord God, you are God and your words are true and you have said you will give your servant this good thing;

entries.title: II Samuel 7:29
segments: So may it be your pleasure to give your blessing to the family of your servant, so that it may go on for ever before you: (for you, O Lord God, have said it,) and may your blessing be on your servant's family line for ever!
